for_loop.quote: A for loop moves i on by one each pass; so i goes 0, 1, 2 and; so on up to 9
for_loop.rule: wrong rule: A loop variable always goes up or down by 1, whatever the update says (so i = i - 4 is read as i--). Right rule: The loop variable changes exactly as the update expression says (i += 2, i = i - 4, i *= 2, ...).
